settings.heading: Shipping Policy
settings.body:
Orders are processed after payment confirmation and fraud review. Processing time varies by product, supplier, inventory status, destination, holidays, and order volume. Estimated processing time: [Insert Processing Time].

Delivery times shown on product pages, checkout, emails, or advertisements are estimates unless expressly stated as guaranteed. Estimated delivery time: [Insert Estimated Delivery Range].

Because this store may use supplier or fulfillment partner shipping, delivery time can vary by item and destination. Some orders may ship in separate packages.

If we cannot ship within the stated timeframe, we will notify you and provide options as required, which may include consenting to the delay or canceling for a refund.

Customers are responsible for entering a complete and accurate shipping address. Contact [Support Email] immediately if an address needs correction. We cannot guarantee changes after an order has been processed or shipped.

If tracking shows delivered but you did not receive the package, check the delivery location, household members, neighbors, building staff, mailroom staff, and carrier before contacting support.

For international orders, customers may be responsible for customs duties, import taxes, brokerage fees, or local charges unless checkout specifically states otherwise.

Replace shipping regions, processing times, delivery estimates, and [Support Email] before publishing this policy.
